adversarial: finding() stamped with the EXCLUDED tag 'dialog-self-dismissal' is REFUSED loudly (a finding_with_invalid_defect_class judgment naming the tag and its posture; no finding recorded) — a closed candidate can never key a finding by accident.

finding() stamped with any of the six Table 3 POSTURE candidates is REFUSED loudly as 'candidate' — candidates are recorded and hunted but price nothing until a dated constitution amendment freezes them.

finding() stamped with an invented/unknown tag is REFUSED loudly as 'unknown' — no check or contract convenience can mint a new class; a new class enters only by hand-verified instance filed as a dated amendment to the constitution, with defectclasses.py changing only in step with that amendment.

A record written by hand around finding() is outside the machinery's reach (named limit 2) — replay must not treat the module's presence alone as proof every row was validated; the validation claim covers rows produced through finding() only.
